verdict.rationale: Orb documents managed daily exports of resource types to a data destination of your choice and revenue exports for financial systems. A paginated list API also allows programmatic extraction of resources. However, the evidence never states which formats are used, whether exports cover all data (e.g. raw events), or how offboarding works. Missing for 10: explicit open-format specification (CSV/Parquet/JSON), confirmation that exports cover all data including raw usage events, a documented offboarding path, and independent hands-on corroboration.
